objective: Unmodified pinned YOPO main GradTrajOptimizer, original bucket ESDF, identical quintic horizon, same15 initial primitive end states
gradient: Raw world-frame gradient, without network-only asymmetric clipping

scaled_gd50.classification: explicit reconstruction, not an exact claim about the unpublished paper expert driver
scaled_gd50.return_policy: best finite evaluated endpoint; accepted updates and total evaluations both reported

mma50_evaluations.classification: cited2017 algorithm choice, adapted objective-evaluation budget; NOT50gradient updates
mma50_evaluations.difference_from_2017: fixed single-segment main objective/free endpoints, no original2017 position/velocity/acceleration box constraints or time budgets

data_rule: Validate numerical implementation on development/training maps first. Freeze settings before evaluating independent formal test maps.
latency_rule: Report C++ optimization wall time separately from Python setup/batching and neural inference; do not present Python overhead as the original expert latency.
